This kind, laid on the fire, melts in great parts like resin, and burns away in a few moments, wrh a bright flame and perfumed smell. Its scent, while in the mafs, is very fragrant and agreeable ; and its taste acrid and bitterish, but very aromatic and agreeable: it is so variable in its colour, that some have divided t into three kinds, the one variegated with black and purple ; the second, with the same black, but with yellowish instead of purple ; and the third, yellow alone, like the yolk of an egg: this last is the lead, scented of the three ; the fuMfance however, in them all, is the same in every respect, except their colour It is brought from Cochinchina.

We meet with it in small fragments, which have been cut and split from larger : these are of a tolerably dense texture in the mere solid pieces, and of a dusky brown colour, variegated with resinous black veins.
